sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, geometric-centre x/y in the deck-SVG coordinate space, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/msc/msc-poesia/vlatest/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one element with class "cabin-shape" and a data-cabin attribute per stateroom (rect + polygon). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to an MSC stateroom category, verified per-colour against sister ships MSC World Europa and MSC Fantasia deckmaps legends (identical MSC colour convention) and cross-checked against cruisedeckplans.com MSC Poesia category pages (Interior / Oceanview / Balcony / Suite). MSC Poesia is the on-deckmaps representative of the Musica class (MSC Musica itself is not published on deckmaps).

notes.completeness: PARTIAL grid, and a MUSICA-CLASS TEMPLATE. deckmaps publishes only 5 deck pages for MSC Poesia (decks 5, 6, 8, 9, 10); deck 6 carries 0 stateroom shapes (public deck), so staterooms come from decks 5, 8, 9 and 10 only. 640 cabin shapes were extracted (deck 5: 63, deck 8: 208, deck 9: 188, deck 10: 181), matching deckmaps' own advertised 640-cabin total for this ship exactly. MSC Poesia's real capacity is ~1,275 staterooms, so this file covers only about half the ship: the entire upper cabin block on decks 11, 12, 13 and 14 (predominantly Balcony, plus the Suites and many Interior cabins) is NOT served by deckmaps and is therefore ABSENT here. It is NOT invented. Missing vs published rough split: ~163 Balcony, ~229 Interior, ~125 Ocean View and the ~18 Suites are the shortfall, concentrated on decks 11-14. MUSICA-CLASS TEMPLATE NOTE: MSC Musica, MSC Orchestra and MSC Magnifica are near-identical Musica-class sisters; MSC Musica is not on deckmaps, so this Poesia extraction serves as the Musica-class stateroom template. The cabin geometry, categories and deck layout transfer to the sisters via cabin-number swaps, but individual cabin numbers here are Poesia's own and were NOT verified against the sisters.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 6 distinct fills map to 3 category buckets. Interior is the single pink #f2a9c5 (42). Balcony uses 3 green shades #4ca66f (204) + #338867 (165) + #00443d (58) = 427 — the same three greens confirmed as Balcony on sister ships MSC World Europa and MSC Fantasia. Ocean View uses 2 blues: #447dbf (67, decks 5 & 8) is the standard MSC Ocean View blue (identical to World Europa) and is confirmed by deck 5, the lowest cabin deck, which is all porthole/window cabins with no possible balconies; #9ad0f3 (104) appears only on deck 8 as a lighter blue — deck 8 is the lifeboat/promenade deck, so these are almost certainly lifeboat-obstructed ocean-view cabins, but MSC/deckmaps colour-codes them as Ocean View and Musica class has no Studio / Infinite Ocean View / Yacht Club categories, so both blues are reported as Ocean View (171 total). No Suite colour appears in the captured decks — Poesia's suites sit on the missing upper decks. Colour reference: MSC World Europa + MSC Fantasia deckmaps legends, cross-checked against cruisedeckplans.com category totals.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. x is the length axis, y the beam. Bow direction detected from cabin numbering: the lowest sequence numbers (8003, 9004, 10001) sit at maximum x, so forward = high-x third, aft = low-x third, mid = middle third of the global cabin x-extent (86.31-685.87). Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam at mid-y (85.22): cabins above (low y) labelled port, below (high y) starboard. Matches the observed parity on this bow-to-high-x plan — odd numbers run along low-y (top/port), even numbers along high-y (bottom/starboard). PORT/STARBOARD CAVEAT: this could be uniformly mirrored versus the real ship — validate against a known cabin before relying on side. Forward-facing and near-centreline cabins are least reliable.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no explicit obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (the source does not assert clear view). NOTE: the deck-8 #9ad0f3 ocean-view cabins are likely lifeboat-obstructed in reality (see category note), but this is inferred, not encoded, so it is not flagged per-cabin.
